parameters.content:
## AI product descriptions

Writes a short intro for each Shopify product you tag `describe`, from its own specs and the maker's page, checks every number in code, and asks you in Slack before anything changes. Only the intro is replaced: the lists, tables and headings below it stay as they are. Intros you approve become examples for the next batch.

### How it works
1. **Setup** (run once) creates `description_drafts`, `description_examples` and `source_pages`, adds a Manufacturer page product field, and seeds three examples.
2. **Write** (every 3 hours) reads tagged products, collects their facts, trims the maker's page, writes a draft with examples from the same product type, checks numbers and model codes, and posts a card with an edit box.
3. **Review** (Slack buttons) checks Slack's signature. Approve saves the text in the box and starts Push; Reject marks the draft.
4. **Push** (called by Review, hourly backstop) reads the live description, swaps only the intro and saves it as an example.

### Setup
1. Credentials: Custom Auth with your Shopify client ID and secret on the three **Get Shopify token** nodes, Slack API on the Slack nodes, Crypto with your Slack signing secret on **Sign the request**, Ollama on **Ollama Chat Model**.
2. Fill in the three settings nodes. Write your `brand_voice`.
3. Run **Run once to set up**, then replace the seed rows with your own best descriptions.
4. Point your Slack app's Interactivity URL at **Slack button click**.
5. Test with a few IDs in `product_ids` and `dry_run` on, then publish.

### Customisation
- Swap **Ollama Chat Model** for any chat model sub-node.
- Change `intro_ends_at` if your intros contain lists.
- Add standards for your niche to `always_ok`.

## Setup (run once)
Creates the three data tables, adds the Manufacturer page field to products, and seeds three example descriptions. Safe to run again.

parameters.content:
## Write (every 3 hours)
Reads products tagged `describe` (or the IDs in `product_ids`), collects their facts, trims the maker's page, writes a draft with examples from the same product type, checks every number in code, posts a card with an edit box and removes the tag.

nodes.name: Write settings

parameters.jsonOutput:
{
  "store_domain": "your-store.myshopify.com",
  "queue_tag": "describe",
  "product_ids": [],
  "batch_size": 5,
  "model": "gemma4:31b",
  "brand_voice": "Plain-spoken and friendly, like a shop assistant who knows the gear and likes it. Short sentences, everyday words, no hype.",
  "min_facts": 5,
  "min_words": 60,
  "max_chars_manufacturer": 5000,
  "max_chars_supplier": 1500,
  "manufacturer_url_namespace": "custom",
  "manufacturer_url_key": "manufacturer_url",
  "intro_ends_at": ["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "ul", "ol", "table", "dl", "div", "section", "figure", "img", "iframe", "video", "hr", "blockquote", "details"],
  "user_agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; YourStore product bot; +https://your-store.com)",
  "slack_channel": "#review-descriptions",
  "spec_words": ["spec", "dimension", "size", "weight", "material", "capacity", "power", "battery", "resolution", "lens", "port", "speed", "rating", "includes", "in the box", "compatib", "feature", "install", "mount"],
  "always_ok": ["RJ45", "H.264", "H.265", "Cat6", "802.3af", "802.3at", "19-inch", "USB-C", "24/7"],
  "banned_phrases": ["cutting-edge", "industry-leading", "seamless", "state-of-the-art", "best-in-class", "game changer", "look no further", "in today's world", "whether you're", "when it comes to", "warranty"],
  "strip_patterns": ["warranty", "free shipping", "ships within", "buy now"]
}

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $('Collect examples').first().json;
const page = String($input.first().json.focused_text || '');
const prompt = [
  'PRODUCT: ' + p.title,
  'Brand: ' + p.vendor + ' | Product type: ' + p.category,
  '',
  'SPECS',
  [p.specs, p.desc_specs].filter(Boolean).join('\n') || '(none)',
  '',
  'MANUFACTURER TEXT',
  page || '(none)',
  '',
  'SUPPLIER COPY',
  p.supplier_copy || '(none)',
  '',
  'APPROVED EXAMPLES (voice and shape only, different products, never copy their facts)',
  p.examples || '(none)'
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { ...p, prompt, context: [p.title, p.vendor, p.specs, p.desc_specs, page, p.supplier_copy].join('\n') } }];

nodes.name: Write the description

parameters.text:
={{ $json.prompt }}

Write the description:
- 2 or 3 sentences on what it is and who it suits.
- Then 1 or 2 short paragraphs on owning it and setting it up.
80 to 150 words in total. No bullet list: the page already lists the specs below your text.
Use only numbers that appear above.
Separate paragraphs with a blank line and return nothing else.

messageValues.message:
=You write product descriptions for an online store.
Voice: {{ $('Write settings').first().json.brand_voice }} Match the approved examples.
- Lead with what the product does for the buyer.
- Fit use cases to where the product is made to be used.
- Explain a technical term the first time you use it.
- State facts only from the specs and source text. Never invent a number or a feature.
- No warranty, shipping or price. No em dashes.

nodes.notes: Errors go to Check the draft too, which saves them as failed.

### Writes to Shopify
Removes the `describe` tag so the product isn't picked up again.

## Review (Slack buttons)
Answers Slack at once, checks the signature and that the draft is still pending. Approve saves the text in the edit box and starts Push; Reject marks the draft. The card then shows the decision.

nodes.notes: An empty 200 at once, inside Slack's 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Sign the request
nodes.notes: Crypto credential: Hmac Secret = your Slack app's Signing Secret.

nodes.name: Signature valid?
nodes.notes: Taps that didn't come from your Slack app stop here.

nodes.name: Get pending draft
nodes.notes: A second click, or a click on an old card, finds nothing and stops here.

nodes.name: Send to Push lane
nodes.notes: Starts the Push lane on this canvas ($workflow.id) without waiting, so the card updates at once.

## Push (called by Review, hourly backstop)
Reads the live description, swaps only the intro (everything from the first heading, list or table down stays), writes it to Shopify, saves the text as an example and replies under the card.
